# Awesome Cordova Plugins

## Awesome Cordova Plugins

- [Welcome](https://danielsogl.gitbook.io/awesome-cordova-plugins/readme.md): Awesome Cordova Plugins provides TypeScript wrappers for Cordova and Ionic native plugins with Promise and Observable support for Angular, React, and Capacitor apps.
- [Installation](https://danielsogl.gitbook.io/awesome-cordova-plugins/installation.md): How to install Awesome Cordova Plugins in Angular, React, and TypeScript projects using Cordova or Capacitor.
- [FAQ](https://danielsogl.gitbook.io/awesome-cordova-plugins/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about Awesome Cordova Plugins — troubleshooting builds, resolving plugin conflicts, and recommended upgrade strategies.
- [Overview](https://danielsogl.gitbook.io/awesome-cordova-plugins/plugins/plugins.md): Browse over 250 Cordova plugin wrappers for Ionic with TypeScript support. Each plugin includes installation instructions, supported platforms, and usage documentation.

## Querying This Documentation
If you need additional information, you can query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.
Perform an HTTP GET request on a page URL with the `ask` query parameter:
```

```
The question should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
Use this mechanism when the answer is not explicitly present in the current page, you need clarification or additional context, or you want to retrieve related documentation sections.
